build_gtn_graph: build a weighted finite state transducer graph using gtn.Graph with add_node and add_arc
compose_gtn_graphs: compose two gtn graphs together using gtn.compose to chain transducer operations
test_forward_score: test the forward score of a gtn graph using gtn.forward_score to compute log-sum-exp
test_viterbi_path: test the viterbi path of a gtn graph using gtn.viterbi_path to find the best path
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a gtn graph using gtn.remove to simplify the automaton
